Like everyone else is saying, you will want mods to make the game smoother, look better, and add more interesting items and combat. First thing, go to steam and search for Skyrim Script Extender in the Store. It is abbreviated SKSE and sets the game up for you to be able to use all the mods. It puts another game in your Steam library called SKSE and it loads your Skyrim game through their extender. Head over to Nexus mods, download the Nexus Mod Manager. Have it search out and find Skyrim on your PC. then go to the Skyrim page on Nexus mods, filter for the top downloads, and start downloading all of them.

SkyUI, Immersive Armors and Immersive Weapons, Apocalypse spells, an ENB (any of them work really, find the one you like best), then atmosphere and terrain mods to make the game prettier, and character mods to make models smoother and nicer looking. Anything else you get is personal preference.
Thanks guys for all the suggestions, you rock my socks. I will definitely follow your advice and make Skyrim rock even more. Woo!

If you want to use destruction magic you should start early to level it, it's the biggest pain to level and if you neglect it you will have trouble killing things later in the game with low destruction. That said the other magic schools are easy to level and you can level up fast by powerleveling something specific. I warn you to go for all the low hanging fruits first though as you will find all the enemys scale with your level which you can get up by leveling non combat skills.
